item.subject: science
item.stem: A large forest area near Meena's village in Assam is cut down completely. After some months of heavy rain, what is most likely to happen to the soil and the animals of that area?

options.A: The soil stays in place because the roots remain after the trunks are cut
options.B: The fresh leaves left behind quickly turn into new fertile soil
options.C: The soil is washed away more easily and animals lose their food and shelter
options.D: Only the wood supply changes, while the soil quality and animal life stay the same
